items.description: Served as a member of the University Senate, contributing to university-wide governance and academic policy.
Committee member for the Provost and Vice-President Academic Search Committee.
Served on a University Governance Committee as part of graduate student leadership.
Served on multiple University of Saskatchewan award selection committees, including the Distinguished Researcher Award.
Served on College of Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies (CGPS) committees, and presented graduate-student reports to University Council and college/faculty councils.

Helping new graduate students navigate grad life through the Peer Assisted Learning (PAL) program, delivering small-group workshops and one-to-one sessions on academic skills and the transition into graduate studies.
Reviewed multiple Software Engineering conferences and Journal submissions
